fields.label: Auto-create Production Plan on Sales Plan Approval

fields.description: What happens when a Sales Plan is Returned to Draft or Cancelled while a live (non-cancelled) Production Plan is linked to it. Block is recommended.
fields.label: Sales Plan Return/Cancel with Live Production Plan

fields.description: When on, a sellable item can only be planned for a branch if it is on an enabled URY Menu for that branch. Non-sellable (semi-finished) items are exempt.
fields.label: Require Active Menu Item for Sales Plan Items

fields.description: When on, submitting a Production Plan (whether via the auto-create-on-Sales-Plan-approval path or a manual submit) also creates and submits a Work Order for each of its items -- stopping there, ready for Material Transfer/Start. Material transfer and manufacture are never automated.
fields.label: Auto-create and Submit Work Orders on Production Plan Submit
